steps.title: Hey Baby, You made it to Milwaukee!
body: The home of my first pet's namesake, "Laverne & Shirley". Black and tan gerbil roommates whose adventures would've made the legendary gal pals proud. I guess I was Lenny and Squiggy all rolled up in one. OMG, do you know "Laverne DeFazio" was Penny freakin Marshall, you know, the director who taught us the most important rule about baseball? Crazy the coincidences. you hangin' with my fav of your buds just like L&S AND the World Series at the same time, with the party literally at your door step. Wild.

Well, I made this for you to be a little cheat sheet for your trip. It's got all sorts of useful stuff in it. Look around and if you think of something else you want me to add, let me know. Have a really, really, really good time and send me pics of any sightings of folks I know.
Love you, I'm gonna go sleep now.

steps.title: Three nights, two games, one bridge.
body: Your hotel is on one side of the Milwaukee River and the theater is on the other, three minutes apart on foot. Doors are at 6:30 every night and the show starts at 8.

The street party outside the theater opens at noon with a free band at 5:30. The Brewers throw the first pitch at 7:00 Friday and Saturday, so the city will be loud when you walk out. Sunday the baseball rests and you do not.

steps.title: Cards, closed until you want them.
body: Every card starts closed. Tap a title to open it. The first time a card opens there is a note from me inside (read it once, tap Got it, and it stays gone).
Tap the star on a card you keep coming back to. It moves up near the top and opens on its own from then on.

steps.title: Locked, on purpose.
body: The map stays locked so the page scrolls past it without a fight. Tap Unlock when you want to move around in it, and it locks itself again when you scroll away.
Every pin is a card. The chips above the map narrow it to food, bars, the game, or Laverne and Shirley.

steps.title: The first card is mine.
body: Lineups when they post, a change of plan, a place I found at 2 AM, it goes in that first card and the card says new until you open it.
Have the best weekend. Love you. Text me anything you want added, or anything you want gone.
